name: Westfield Oakridge
summary: Westfield Oakridge is a major regional shopping mall in South San Jose featuring anchor stores like Macy's, Target, and Nordstrom Rack, alongside popular retailers including Apple, H&M, and UNIQLO. The center offers comprehensive entertainment with a 20-screen Century theater, Bowlero, and diverse dining options from Shake Shack to full-service restaurants.
demographics: Westfield Oakridge attracts a diverse, middle to upper-middle income demographic from the South San Jose area, including families and young professionals from nearby tech industry employment centers. The trade area serves a multicultural population with significant Asian-American representation, reflecting the broader Silicon Valley demographics. Primary shoppers include households with annual incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+, with a strong presence of dual-income families seeking convenient access to both everyday necessities and specialty retail. The center appeals to value-conscious yet brand-aware consumers who appreciate the mix of department stores, fast fashion, and dining options in a single destination.
description: Westfield Oakridge stands as a premier shopping destination in South San Jose, offering an extensive retail experience at 925 Blossom Hill Road. This enclosed regional mall features major anchor stores including Macy's, Macy's Backstage, Target, and Nordstrom Rack, complemented by popular national retailers such as Apple, H&M, UNIQLO, Old Navy, and Hollister Co. Beyond shopping, the center provides comprehensive entertainment options with Century Oakridge 20 movie theater and Bowlero bowling facility, making it a true lifestyle destination for the entire family. The dining scene ranges from casual favorites like Shake Shack and BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse to Izumi Seafood & Sushi Buffet, plus specialty treats from See's Candies and Lolli and Pops. With amenities including free Wi-Fi, convenient parking, and the Westfield mobile app for enhanced shopping convenience, Westfield Oakridge serves as a central gathering place for the South Bay community, combining retail therapy with entertainment and dining in one accessible location.
